summaryZh: Palsson 实验室的系统生物学研究组结合实验与计算方法，研究从基因组到表型的细胞生命复杂性。研究包括代谢与调控网络重建、微生物群落相互作用，以及利用约束建模、多组学整合和适应性实验室进化研究代谢与适应。
researchQuestions: 如何以系统层面模型解释细胞功能、代谢和微生物适应？

evidence.quote: Welcome to the Palsson Lab at UC San Diego Home of the Systems Biology Research Group
We study the complexity of cellular life using experimental and computational methods that span the genome to the phenotype.
We develop in silico methods for constraint-based modeling, network reconstruction, and integrated analysis of multiple types of omics data.
We study the interplay of different members of a microbial community
We use adaptive laboratory evolution in defined conditions to study the dynamics of bacterial adaptation in response to environmental and genetic challenges.
